triangles.why: Congruence: marks fixed so they match the theorem. SAS marked an angle outside the two sides (now the angle between them); ASA marked a side outside the two angles (now the side between them); SSA marks the angle opposite the longer of the two sides.
triangles.old: else if(theorem==='צ.ז.צ') marks={sides:[1,0,2],angles:[0,0,1]}; // two sides + included angle
triangles.new: else if(theorem==='צ.ז.צ') marks={sides:[1,0,2],angles:[1,0,0]}; // two sides (AB, AC) + included angle A
